body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2005') -- <Visual News> NEOSOL(www.neosoltech.com) has announced that it plans to release its new PMP ‘CP-3550’. The most intriguing feature of this model is that you can choose either navigation module or DMB module at the time you purchase the model; then it will be equipped accordingly. It supports most of codecs such as MPEG1/2/4, AVI, ASF, WMV9 SP, H.264. With TV-out, you can enjoy multimedia contents with big screen. If you need more information, visit the website www.neosoltech.com or contact 82-53-587-3600 <AVING Special Report Team for ‘KES2005’ : Editor&Publisher, Jason Lee, Joshua Shim, Nikki Whang, Sheri Choi, Sophia Kwag, Annie Park, Caleb Ma, edited by Daniel Sirh>
